title: Regrimstone
description: Renames deepslate items and blocks back into the snapshot name, Grimstone!
body:
Renames deepslate items and blocks back into the snapshot name, Grimstone!

I have not tested the versions it works on, I made it a while back. Currently using on 1.21 and it seems to work fine, so I'm assuming it'll work on all versions containing deepslate related items.
